$comment: YOY-119 vision-model comparison sample. 40 products from the live seed (unfiltered-dev), tentree and whitestuff catalogs, up to 4 public image URLs each. key = hand label from inspecting the images (value = canonical answer, accept = also-correct answers). nonSoldItems = garments/shoes/accessories visible in the shots that are NOT the product; a model output that carries any of their attributes (category, colour, pattern, material) not shared by the sold item counts as contamination. flags: contamination = model wearing other items; text-sparse = product text < 80 chars; flat = flat/packshot only; text-conflict = product text contradicts the image.

products.title: Quilted Colville Overshirt
products.text: Keep you warm and fashionable for any season you desire. This sustainable Colville Longsleeve shirt is made from our blend of Organic Cotton and Recycled Polyester, which happens to be good for the planet.

products.text: One word: pockets. This fit-and-flare midi dress is made from an eco-conscious blend of recycled materials that offers stretch, an all-in-one outfit, and a place to put your hands.

products.title: Hopewell Dress
products.text: This tiered dress is a must-have for summer for a couple of reasons. One, it looks great. Two, it's made with natural hemp and Tencel fibres, so you can stay outside longer. Bonus.

products.title: Sunday Jacket
products.text: With the silhouette of a shirt and the warmth of a jacket, weather any season with this indoor-outdoor essential. Its relaxed fit's perfect for layering with your favorite sweater.

products.title: Begbie Full Zip

They’re made in our garment-washed organic cotton so they’re surfaced yet soft.

products.title: Sasquatch T-Shirt

products.title: Yaletown Skirt
